question: An arc on a circle, whose length is 19.25 cm, subtends an 18° angle at the centre. What is the area of the circle? [Usе π = (22)/(7)]
solution:
**Given:**

An arc on a circle, whose length is 19.25 cm, subtends an 18° angle at the centre

**Concept used:**

Arc Length = θ × r, Where

r = Radius, θ is in radian

**Calculation:**

18° = π/10 rad

So,

r = (19.25 × 10)/π

r = 192.5/π

Area of the circle is

⇒ π × (192.5 /π) × (192.5 /π) 

⇒ 11790.625 cm2

**∴ The correct option is 4**
